Changes.note: “Appoint a ders nazırı” makes the person you found a ders nazırı of this course and gives them the permissions you chose; the post and its permissions lapse together at the end you set. You can give only permissions you hold; if you appoint through a permission you were given, the person starts with none. Everyone who can open this page sees the ders nazırları. “Edit permissions” replaces everything the post holds; “Dismiss” takes the post and every permission in the course away at once. Every appointment, change and dismissal is written to the audit log; a dismissed person can be appointed again, but their permissions must be given again.
